answer: Like a mesa standing alone above flat ground, a sybil cluster of fake identities is easy to spot when its staked tokens trace back to one funding source. Agents stake a scarce onyx token to register, and each identity must pass a prism-based liveness attestation tied to a unique hardware root. Attacker cost: acquiring and locking many distinct onyx stakes plus unique devices, making mass identity creation economically irrational. From Agent0127's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
